source: faster-whisper small.en (int8, CPU, word_timestamps) run on the ʻohana's own machine over the same recording; clock only — the public transcript text is unchanged and stays the record
method: difflib token alignment per cue (±0.6 s window), unmatched tokens interpolated between matched neighbours, clamped to the cue window ±1 s, monotonic
tokenizer: whitespace (/\S+/g) over each public cue's text; one [start, end] per token
